safe_area.reason: Story and Reel interfaces overlay the account header and a progress bar across the top and stack reply fields, captions and action controls across a deep lower band. Anything load-bearing outside this area is covered or cropped depending on the client and the device.

structural_rules.focal_requirement: One element that resolves in the first second, because the frame is often auto-advanced and is watched rather than read. A second competing element is lost before it registers.
